findings: Treatment and mock preparations are explicit separate components of collection States, with persistent physical_context statements and treatment-specific cDNA attribution.
The final reverse-transcription information effect distinguishes DNA reporters from RNA chemical modifications and names the minus-CMC background comparison.
Two primary-supported catalogue corrections remain explicit: RNA size-selection order and peak-statistic description.
Compactness is supported for this example, not an accuracy metric or proof of general improvement.
Treatment correspondence is partly natural-language annotation; this test does not establish component-level traversal by the graph tools.
scope_limit: One follow-up on a selected method. No fresh old-prompt control, blind expert adjudication or causal attribution of improvement. Same model and source bytes; independent model review is not proof of biological correctness.
